name: Multi-file and multi-hunk patch
description: Multi-file defects requiring separate hunk replacements across math_ops.py and formatter.py.
expected_behavior: Multiplication, average calculation, and currency formatting all work properly.
golden_patch:
--- a/math_ops.py
+++ b/math_ops.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float:
-    return a + b
+    return a * b
@@ -8,2 +8,2 @@
-    return sum(nums) / (len(nums) - 1)
+    return sum(nums) / len(nums)
--- a/formatter.py
+++ b/formatter.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def format_currency(amount: float) -> str:
-    return f"{amount:.2f}"
+    return f"${amount:.2f}"
